_comment: Minimal Pterodactyl egg for DerenguhGram-Proxy. Import via Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg. Python generic docker image, no root, 128MB-friendly.
name: DerenguhGram Proxy
author: derenguh@example.org
description: Fake-TLS compressing MTProto transport proxy (DerenguhProto). Runs without root, port from SERVER_PORT.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git python3-pip
cd /mnt/server
git clone ${GIT_REPO} src || (cd src && git pull)
cp -r src/DerenguhGram-Proxy/derenguh_proxy ./
if [ -f src/DerenguhGram-Proxy/requirements.txt ]; then pip install --no-cache-dir -r src/DerenguhGram-Proxy/requirements.txt; fi
echo 'Installation complete.'

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: IP or domain shown in the connection link.

variables.name: Proxy Secret (hex)
variables.description: 32-char hex (16 bytes). Leave empty to auto-generate (changes on restart).

variables.name: Default SNI
variables.description: Streaming host used in the link and as the splice fallback.

variables.name: Codec
variables.description: Preferred compression codec: none, zlib, brotli.
